_comment: MCP config for the Governed Agentic Companion front door. Copy ONE server entry into your IDE's MCP config (Kiro: .kiro/settings/mcp.json — gitignored; Claude Code: .mcp.json or the plugin) and MERGE with any existing mcpServers. Never commit real paths, ARNs, tokens, or account ids. Two options — use ONE. Both expose the same two governed tools (ask_companion, companion_kb); responses are gated in the cloud.

option_A_local_bridge._comment: Kiro/Claude Code spawn frontdoor/mcp_bridge.py as a stdio MCP server. The bridge mints + auto-refreshes a Cognito access token and relays each call to the deployed AgentCore runtime. Set the absolute path to your clone and fill the env from your gitignored ~/.companion-frontdoor.env. Best for a hands-off setup and as the gateway-down fallback.

option_B_gateway_http._comment: Point the IDE's MCP client (an http server) at the AgentCore Gateway's full path-based invocations URL with a Bearer JWT. Keep the token fresh with frontdoor/gateway_token.py (print/write-env/daemon). Use this once the gateway is stood up; keep option A as the offline fallback.
